newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker, recovers early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker, recovers early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from early losses and finished at 43.7500/7700 to the dollar against Monday's close at 43.7500/7600, dealers said. Dealers said heavy government borrowing from banks in recent weeks had tightened liquidity.
The taka plunged to 43.7700/7900 per dollar in early trade but later recovered as call rates remained at a higher level for a third straight session.
Interbank call money was traded between nine to 11 percent against a previous 8.0-11 percent. - Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
